[EN] Want to howl with the wolves?

During the event, Corsairs' Stronghold will be infested by wolves every Friday, Saturday, and Sunday from 8 PM to 11 PM (CEST)!

Take your place on the battleground and collect their teeth as trophies. In exchange for them, I'll give you some handy items. Those teeth will make a pretty necklace for my alpha female... um, for my wife.
[ES] ¿Quieres aullar con los lobos?

Durante el evento, Corsairs' Stronghold se verá infestado de lobos todos los viernes, sábados y domingos de 20:00 a 23:00 (CEST).

Toma tu lugar en el campo de batalla y recolecta sus colmillos como trofeos. A cambio, te daré algunos objetos útiles. Esos colmillos harán un collar muy bonito para mi alfa... ejem, para mi esposa.
